mappings.scenario: An attacker replays stolen customer session cookies to place orders as another shopper at checkout.

categories.name: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control

mappings.scenario: An attacker edits the cart total in the browser before the order is submitted, and the server trusts the client price.
A customer disputes a completed order and the service cannot show who placed it because order events are not logged.
The order lookup endpoint returns another customer's shipping address when the order number is changed in the URL.

categories.name: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control

mappings.scenario: Bots flood the coupon validation endpoint during a sale and exhaust the checkout database connection pool.
A support agent account can call the refund API without a second approval and issue refunds to any card.

categories.name: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control

GV.name: Govern
GV.summary: Establish, communicate, and monitor the organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy.

ID.name: Identify
ID.summary: Develop the organization's understanding to manage cybersecurity risk to systems, people, assets, data, and capabilities.

PR.name: Protect
PR.summary: Develop and implement appropriate safeguards to ensure delivery of critical services.

DE.name: Detect
DE.summary: Develop and implement appropriate activities to identify the occurrence of a cybersecurity event.

RS.name: Respond
RS.summary: Develop and implement appropriate activities to take action regarding a detected cybersecurity incident.

RC.name: Recover
RC.summary: Develop and implement appropriate activities to maintain plans for resilience and to restore any capabilities or services that were impaired due to a cybersecurity incident.
